summary: Senstar Technologies filed a routine Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated November 6, 2026. Revenue rose 37% year-over-year to a record $13.1 million, with U.S. up 23% and EMEA and APAC each up 50%; GAAP net income was $1.5 million versus $1.0 million, and adjusted EBITDA $2.1 million, up 55%. Cash and short-term deposits totaled $8.4 million with no debt, down from $22.5 million at year-end 2025. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary quarterly results announcement, not a special situation.
